verdicts.criticalReason: The PR directly contradicts the Acceptance Criteria by completely omitting the implementation of the required 'role sync' mechanism (and its corresponding mandatory integration tests). The only changes are replacing the string-based extractJsonValue with Jackson's readTree and adding tests for 400/401/403 endpoints, but the core role sync requirement for JWTs remains unaddressed.

concerns.text: The updated extractJsonValue swallows Exception, returning an empty string which may silently mask malformed JSON payloads instead of failing explicitly.
